Show HN: Recalc – Spreadsheet where cells can be Claude Code or Codex terminals
articles.text: I built this because it was useful for me when building evals/benchmarks, and I decided to put it up for free for others. The goal was quite simple, make it easy to use a lead claude code / codex session in a panel on the side, while allowing every cell to also be a terminal session running claude/codex, and make it possible to continue a session in an actual terminal window if I needed to. articles.title: Show HN: Micron – Oberon with the Power of C
articles.text: I have been developing Micron (for "MicroOberon"), a lean, statically typed, modular systems programming language that combines Oberon’s simplicity and explicit module structure with C’s low-level capabilities and interoperability. Micron is not my first langage design. I first built Oberon+, a modernized and unified Oberon, in order to under­ stand, by implementing it and by porting real systems to it, what Wirth’s design actually gives and where it fails.
